title: Heavy rain, wind, flooding plague much of US on Thanksgiving holiday

blocks.text: NEW YORK — Thanksgiving storms brought foul weather to the East Coast and other parts of the US on Thursday, causing coastal and power outages and prompting the postponement of Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade. High winds and flooding hammered both coasts, snarling holiday travel. More than 800,000 homes and businesses were without electricity Thursday afternoon,
